test_title: PYST 03: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the target number of houses to be built under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) by 2023-2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1.89 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban), the government aims to provide housing for all by 2023-2024, targeting the construction of **1.89 crore houses**.
 
• The scheme was launched on **25 June 2015** by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, focusing on urban areas.
 
• The initiative aims to address the housing shortage among the Economically Weaker Sections (EWS), Low-Income Groups (LIG), and Middle-Income Groups (MIG).
 
• PMAY (Urban) includes four verticals: In-situ Slum Redevelopment, Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS), Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP), and Beneficiary-led Construction (BLC).
 
• By the end of 2022, **over 1.22 crore houses had been sanctioned**, with significant progress in construction and occupancy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)**

 
 
• It is divided into two categories: **PMAY (Urban)** for urban areas and **PMAY (Gramin)** for rural areas.
 
• The scheme aims to achieve "Housing for All" by providing affordable housing to urban poor and rural populations.
 
• Beneficiaries under PMAY are selected based on the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data.
 
 
 
• **Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS)**
 
 
• Under PMAY (Urban), CLSS provides interest subsidies on home loans for beneficiaries in EWS, LIG, and MIG categories.
 
• The subsidy varies based on income groups, with interest rates ranging from **6.5% to 4% annually**.
 
 
 
• **Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP)**
 
 
• Encourages partnerships between public and private sectors to construct affordable housing projects.
 
• Central assistance of up to Rs. 1.5 lakh per house is provided for eligible beneficiaries.
 
 
 
• **Beneficiary-led Construction (BLC)**
 
 
• Under BLC, financial assistance is provided to beneficiaries to build or enhance their own houses.
 
• Beneficiaries receive **up to Rs. 1.5 lakh** for constructing houses on their own land.
